program_name: Oobit Referral Program (in-app, personal; Terms effective 8 November 2026)
application_conditions: No application: every verified Oobit user has a referral code in the app. Referral Terms §2.8: use is 'personal, non-commercial'; codes must not be distributed 'through advertising, paid channels, or to the public at large' unless the user is an 'Authorized Partner' under a separate written agreement (§2.6) — such partner agreements exist but no public partner/affiliate page or application route was found (oobit.com/ambassador only shows the homepage with a 'Global Oobit Ambassador' athlete testimonial, 2026-11-24).
paid_action: Referral Terms (effective and last updated 2026-11-08, read 2026-11-24): Inviter Reward USD 15 per Qualified Invitee — the invitee enters the code before any Payment Attempt, is KYC-verified, and reaches USD 200 cumulative Card Payment Spend within 60 days of redeeming the code (external-wallet payments, swaps, withdrawals, transfers excluded). Invitee reward: waiver of card-payment fees on the first USD 500 of card spend (no cash value). §9.4: these terms 'replace the previous Invite 3, get $50 Inviter Reward'; USD 15 applies to codes redeemed on or after 2026-11-08.
validation_conditions: Both parties KYC-verified (inviter at payout §2.4, invitee to create a card §2.7); one code per user (§4.3); inviter rewards capped at USD 1,500 in total (§3.2); documents may be requested with 14 days to respond (§3.8); refunds/chargebacks do not remove completed spend (§5.3); rewards withheld, reversed or clawed back for suspected abuse (§5.6), set-off or refund within 14 days of request (§5.7). The support-centre article (undated) still describes the older points scheme: 200,000 points each, qualifying payment within 14 days, up to 100 bonuses.

commission.model_note: USD 15 per Qualified Invitee, paid in USDT or USDC (USDC where USDT is not permitted, e.g. the EU), capped at USD 1,500 per inviter (Referral Terms 2026-11-08). The undated support-centre article still shows 200,000 points each (older scheme) and the FAQ (2026-11-06) showed 'USD 50 when three Invitees qualify' — superseded per Terms §9.4. Not a publisher commission.

payout.method: USDT or USDC credited to the inviter's Oobit account (Terms §3.3); invitee's reward is a fee waiver, not a balance
payout.frequency: Credited 'within a reasonable period' after verification (§3.5)
payout.cancellation_note: Oobit may modify, suspend or terminate the Program at any time with or without notice (§9.1); rewards already earned are honoured (§9.2).

rules_note: Referral Terms effective 2026-11-08: personal, non-commercial sharing only (§2.8); no advertising, paid channels or distribution 'to the public at large' unless an Authorized Partner (§2.6); coupon/deal sites and paid search barred (§5.1); no excluded-country list (§2.2 excludes jurisdictions where Oobit does not offer services). Rewards Programme terms (19/10/2026) govern points; Oobit may change or end programmes with 30 days' notice. Support article undated.
allowed_countries_note: Invitee must pass KYC and be able to create a card; USDC paid where USDT is not permitted (e.g. EU). No excluded-country list in the Terms (§2.2).

evidence.title: Oobit Referral Program Terms & Conditions (effective and last updated 8 November 2026)
evidence.excerpt: USD 15 per Qualified Invitee in USDT/USDC (§3.1, 3.3), cap USD 1,500 (§3.2); invitee: fee waiver on first USD 500 card spend (§4.1); qualifying: USD 200 Card Payment Spend within 60 days of code redemption (§3.7); code before any Payment Attempt (§4.2); personal, non-commercial (§2.8), Authorized Partners under separate written agreement exempt (§2.6); §9.4 replaces 'Invite 3, get $50'.

evidence.title: How does the Oobit Referral Program work? (support centre, undated)
evidence.excerpt: Re-read 2026-11-24, unchanged and now outdated versus the 2026-11-08 Terms: 200,000 points each for referrer and referee; qualifying payment within 14 days; up to 100 × 200,000 points; referee never used Tap to Pay; 'Additional terms apply'. No affiliate or partner programme mentioned.

evidence.title: Oobit FAQ — referral programme answers (undated)
evidence.excerpt: 'USD 50 Inviter Reward when three Invitees each become a Qualified Invitee' (USD 200 cumulative card payment spend within 60 days), paid in USDT or USDC, not pro-rated, repeatable, KYC at payout, 'personal, non-commercial sharing with friends and family'.

evidence.title: Oobit Rewards Programme terms (last updated 19/10/2026)
evidence.excerpt: §4 points for referrals (no amounts); 1,000 points = USD 1; §1.8 rewards usable only on Tap to Pay in-app, not withdrawable or transferable.

evidence.title: Oobit referral landing page
evidence.excerpt: 'A friend has given you a crypto card with $500 in fee-free spending'; download the app, copy the referral code; links to the full Terms. No points promise.

notes: Personal referral only. Re-read 2026-11-24: the official Referral Terms (effective 2026-11-08) were read for the first time — USD 15 per qualified invitee (cap USD 1,500), invitee gets USD 500 fee-free card spend; the Terms state they replace the earlier 'Invite 3, get $50' reward. The undated support article still describes the 200,000-points scheme, hence 'contradictory' is kept (dated Terms govern). §2.6 'Authorized Partners' under a separate written agreement is the only sign of a commercial track — no public page, no application route. oobit.com/ambassador returns the homepage. Nobody contacted, nothing submitted.
legal_entity: Oobit Technologies and its affiliates (Referral Terms); governing law per the Oobit Terms of Service §11.1
